0:55–2:00. Use the polished UI on PR #1. The fictional request asks for a navy waterproof daypack of about 20 liters, price and evening pickup. The customer authorizes and the teammate accepts. In the fourth actual microphone run, the teammate asked whether another color was acceptable. An English relay appeared, the human customer answered yes, and the Korean return was recorded. The plan still targeted navy and made an unsupported no-pickup inference, so the teammate disconnected. The repair updates affected questions and reuses applicable business answers. It also clarifies offered alternatives without waiting for an explicit question. A recorded-text real API replay passes, but normal live completion remains unverified. Show the actual result without presenting an interrupted run as success. Sources: docs/v2-pr1-review.md; artifacts/v2/pr1-live-shop-fourth-rehearsal.json; artifacts/v2/pr1-fourth-preference-replay.json. Raw records are retained for local review, not official upload.

User value is Unverified. Official submission: https://ralphthon.org/kakao-ai-dot-2026/#process . Official three-minute guide: https://ralphthon.org/kakao-ai-dot-2026/student-preparation.pdf .
2:00–2:30. Automated checks: 67 unit, 30 localhost HTTP with mocked AI and blocked upstream network, 20 mocked customer UI, 16 mocked business UI, and 32 design checks. The build and eight extracted-archive checks pass. Four actual PR microphone attempts were interrupted. The fourth demonstrated live relay and Korean return, but failed to adapt the current plan to the accepted color alternative. Repairs retain saved transcript metadata for confirmation, detect questions and alternative offers, update current question targets, retain applicable earlier answers and reject inferred answer updates. Three real API requests using recorded fourth-run statements and the actual customer reply passed six checks. An earlier failed replay omitted the resolved stock target and is preserved. Replays do not establish new microphone acceptance. A prior hospital attempt had explicit human audibility confirmation. English, Russian and Chinese UI coverage passes; real-model language fidelity has recorded limits. User value and complete live normal completion remain unverified. Sources: docs/v2-pr1-review.md and the referenced local artifacts.
